visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches down to open a custom white cardboard cake box, revealing a small pink cake decorated with white cream drips and several whole strawberries on top. The background is a warm-toned wooden table. (2) A variety of cakes are arranged on a table with their respective boxes in the background. The camera focuses on the pink cake sitting on a white ceramic pedestal. (3) A knife slices through the pink cake, showing the interior composition of dark-colored sponge cake, thick cream layers, and fresh strawberry halves. (4) A white frosted cake topped with strawberry slices and green herbs rotates on a stand. (5) A slice is lifted from the white cake, revealing white sponge layers and strawberry filling. (6) Close-up shot of a white cake adorned with whole strawberries and small green leaves, looking elegant under bright studio-style lighting. (7) A knife cuts into a green-layered cake with strawberry filling, showing the textural contrast between the sponge and fruit. (8) A towering dark chocolate cake with multiple layers of sliced strawberries is shown in a tight close-up. (9) A slice of the chocolate cake is removed with a server, highlighting the density of the fruit layers. (10) Two rectangular plastic containers filled with a layered strawberry and crumble dessert are held by hands. (11) A wooden spoon scoops into the dessert container, showing a mix of red cake, cream, and strawberries. (12) The scene transitions to the interior of a clean, modern bakery with green walls, display cases, and floral arrangements, ending with a shot of the shop's exterior signage.
